title: Student-Centered Teaching as Experienced by a Participant
coreMove: Let the learner's lived participation reshape the teaching plan in real time.
sourcePressure: The chapter grounds student-centered teaching in participant experience rather than abstract educational theory. No split source sidecar exists for ch15; frozen TOC and book skeleton support the heading, part placement, and broad intent only, with no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating student-centered teaching as loose discussion with no rigor.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of student-centered teaching
